steps.content: A ruined stele appears without warning.

You step closer to examine it. Then the light begins. Crimson, vast, it spreads from beneath the stele like spilled blood finding its way. An ominous presence washes over you, rooting your feet to the ground.
Behind the stele, something moves. A massive, nameless figure crawls into view. Its back is turned to you, limbs twisted at wrong angles yet moving with horrifying grace.
Its neck begins to twist. Turning. Turning. Turning.
Then the eyes. Crimson. Glowing. Staring into you.
